email.subject: AI for Gunderson Dettmer — built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi there,

Gunderson Dettmer's #1 ranking as a VC law firm for twelve consecutive years speaks to your team's ability to handle complex, high-stakes deals across venture capital, growth equity, and emerging companies—all with lean, focused teams. That's exactly the pressure point we solve.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for boutique law firms that face BigLaw demands without BigLaw headcount. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on what matters: precision, client trust, and real efficiency gains on venture and emerging company work.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're expanding into Silicon Valley. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how—as ex-lawyers ourselves—we're helping firms like yours compete and scale.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
